slots.writingObjective: State as a fact about TextOS that a produced article is no longer presented as a validated one.
One sentence for a search result: in TextOS only a passing fact-check and a conforming article may reach WordPress, and a pass is not presented as proof of excellence.
Open on the reader's situation — a dashboard that says an AI article is ready — and say that TextOS stopped equating 'written' with 'checked' in October 2026.

slots.heading: How can you tell an AI article was really checked?
slots.writingObjective: Answer directly: the fact-check verdict is no longer rewritten to pass, a truth alert allows reading and correction but never a WordPress draft, and one rule decides eligibility.
slots.buyerIntent: What exactly is checked before my CMS?

slots.heading: The label on the screen tells the truth
slots.writingObjective: Explain the review screen change: a hard-coded 'validated' label removed, the stored verdict shown, 'not certified' shown on an alert; and that TextOS decides the article's strategy while the writer executes it.
slots.buyerIntent: Does the interface say what really happened?

slots.heading: One rule for what may reach your website
slots.writingObjective: Explain the single eligibility rule (fact-check pass and a conforming article), that it fails closed, that only a quality-gate pass makes an article eligible while 'not evaluated' blocks with its own code, and what the structural check looks at.
Caption the figure of this note in one factual sentence, grounded in the evidence it cites.

slots.heading: What a pass does not prove
slots.writingObjective: Explain that a pass is not presented as proof of excellence, that the gate states what it does not measure (usefulness, argument, originality, source authority, search performance), and that human review judges substance; add that waiting for a writer is shown as waiting, not as failure.
slots.buyerIntent: Does a pass mean the article is good?

slots.heading: Checking that nothing was lost on the way
slots.writingObjective: Explain the continuity checks: missing receipts, masked alerts and drift detected before claiming continuity; a required claim, buyer context or approved fact lost before writing detected even when receipts look consistent; optional material not forced in; and that a consistent receipt is not quality, search effect or permission to publish.
slots.buyerIntent: Could something I asked for silently disappear?

slots.heading: What to ask any AI writing vendor
slots.writingObjective: Give the buyer a short list of questions to put to any vendor, one per sentence, drawn from the mechanisms this note describes. Recommendations only, no claim about TextOS.

slots.heading: Where to go next
